faults.title: Pump Vibration
faults.description: Excessive vibration detected in pump unit
faults.details: The pump is experiencing vibration levels exceeding safe thresholds. This may indicate bearing wear or misalignment. Immediate inspection recommended.

faults.title: Temperature Sensor Malfunction
faults.details: The temperature sensor on the cooling system is not responding correctly. Check sensor connections and calibration. May need replacement.

faults.title: Pressure Valve Failure
faults.details: The pressure relief valve is stuck and not opening at set pressure. This is a critical issue. Stop equipment immediately and investigate.
